description: Skill-value and retirement suites must satisfy docs/system-requirements.md#claim-based-testing-and-retirement. Schema validity alone does not establish claim coverage, oracle sensitivity, comparable outcomes or complete overall accounting.

claim.description: State the source-backed skill claim and intended scope, not merely the checker implementation. Link each material claim to representative real-task outcomes and independent failure-sensitive checks in the existing evaluation record.

comparison_requirements.description: Required before new inference; historical reports remain readable. Predeclare claim fit, equivalent with/without conditions, comparability/tolerances and overall accounting in the governing contract. Unsupported runtime claims fail readiness; these fields alone do not prove semantic adequacy.

stability.description: Declare evidence adequacy, comparability tolerances and trial/order/stopping decisions before running. A non-significant result or underpowered sample is not demonstrated comparability.

cases.description: Exercise the skill stated claim on representative real work and material exceptions. Keep prompts outcome-driven; keep acceptance checks independent and demonstrate sensitivity to the claimed failure. A case count is not coverage.

acceptance_review.description: Required by new-launch oracle_preflight; review declarations plus controls, not semantic proof. See docs/evaluations/outcome-efficiency.md.
